{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    # Extract payload
    payload = case['payload']
    segments = payload['segments']
    budget = payload['budget']
    
    # Build ordered lists
    names = [seg['name'] for seg in segments]
    importances = {seg['name']: seg['importance'] for seg in segments}
    minimums = {seg['name']: seg['minimum'] for seg in segments}
    capacities = {seg['name']: seg['capacity'] for seg in segments}
    
    # Validate budget
    total_min = sum(minimums.values())
    total_cap = sum(capacities.values())
    if budget < total_min or budget > total_cap:
        return {'error': f'Budget {budget} is out of range [{total_min}, {total_cap}]'}
    
    # Initialize allocations at minimums
    allocations = {name: minimums[name] for name in names}
    remaining = budget - total_min
    
    # Greedy allocation
    while remaining > 0:
        best_ratio = -1.0
        best_name = None
        best_idx = None
        for idx, name in enumerate(names):
            if allocations[name] >= capacities[name]:
                continue
            # Ratio = importance / (current_allocation + 1)
            ratio = importances[name] / (allocations[name] + 1)
            if ratio > best_ratio or (ratio == best_ratio and idx < best_idx):
                best_ratio = ratio
                best_name = name
                best_idx = idx
        # Should always find one because remaining > 0 and total capacity > total_min
        allocations[best_name] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    
    # Build result
    result = {
        'allocations': {name: allocations[name] for name in names},
        'names': names,
        'total_allocated': sum(allocations.values()),
        'budget': budget
    }
    return result
"}
